faq.a: Abdullah is associated with the Arabic form عبد الله, whose core sense is servant of allah.

faq.q: What is the origin of Abdullah?
faq.a: Abdullah is associated with Arabic. ʿAbd Allāh ('servant of Allah'). One of the most widely used Muslim given names.
Yes — the underlying form عبد الله is Arabic.
Abdullah can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

Abdullah should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. عبد الله is a well-attested Arabic theophoric name; the element عبد occurs in the Qur'an and the name is borne by the Prophet's father in the sīra tradition

faq.q: What does Abdullah mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Abdullah is rendered عبداللہ and carries the sense اللہ کا بندہ.

faq.q: What does Abdullah mean in Persian?
faq.a: No verified Persian form was established for Abdullah.
A romanized syllable approximation is ab-dul-lah. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Abdullah?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Abdullah, abdullah. Script forms are عبد الله, عبدالله, عبداللہ, अब्दुल्लाह.

faq.q: Is Abdullah a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
